scope: Safe synthetic temporary files, production FirmwareKernelDisk helpers, no real VM / mount / sudo / AMFI operations.
confirmed_finding: The actual capture, validate, publish, and reverse loops accumulate temporary read objects without a per-iteration autoreleasepool. Adding only per-iteration pools changes the memory regression from RED to GREEN.
limits: Synthetic memory/output regression does not establish the cause of the original SIGKILL.
Synthetic tests do not establish real disk publication, committed kernel update, VM boot, or kernel-only rollback acceptance.
The offsets array intentionally scales with the number of changed blocks; these tests bound temporary block storage, not that retained relationship.

experiment.write_changes: every block including a partial 3-byte block
experiment.write_callbacks: no-op save and afterWrite isolate actual helper read/write allocation from journal encoding
experiment.memory_metric: Darwin getrusage ru_maxrss high-water increase, isolated XCTest subprocess per operation

review: Per-block pools cover existing save callbacks but preserve write ordering, durable cursor updates, pending state, thrown errors, and prefix validation. Existing interruption/recovery, unknown modification, journal failure, origin/receipt and binding tests passed.
